{{Quote|Gungans no dyin' witout a fight. Wesa warriors. Wesa got a grand army.|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
The '''Gungan Grand Army''' was a large [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Army/Legends|army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was formed around [[3000 BBY]] by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] during the [[War of the Gungan tribes]] to defeat Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]]. During its history, it fought the [[Gungan–Naboo War]] with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo, enslaving the Naboo people and driving the Gungans out of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].

==History==
===Formations===
[[File:Gungan_Grand_Army.jpg|thumb|left|240px|The Grand Army marches to the Battle of Grassy Plains.]]
It was believed that the first Gungan "grand army" was assembled to [[Bursa–Gungan war|defend]] against [[Bursa/Legends|Bursas]], large and dangerous animals. The grand army eventually drove the bursas to extinction.<ref name="SW:GB Databank" /> Sometime around [[3000 BBY]],<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Grand Army formed at the peak of the [[War of the Gungan tribes]] when [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] united the Gungans to defeat the warlord Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]].<ref name="SW:GB" />

Every Gungan [[City/Legends|city]] was required to hold annual drills for its [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]] so that the Grand Army could be assembled in thirty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===Crisis on Naboo===
{{Quote|Wesa ready to do our-sa part.|Boss Nass in regards to the upcoming battle|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
[[File:Gungan_swk.jpg|thumb|A Gungan warrior during the invasion of Naboo.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Naboo was [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] and [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> By that time, the Grand Army had not been called for over 100 years. It had been maintained to defend against large predators and tradition.<ref name="SW:GB Databank" /> The Naboo people were entirely overwhelmed by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], allowing the Droid Army to turn its attention to subjugating the rest of Naboo.<ref name="SWE1" /> The Droid Army [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|swept through the swamps]], driving out the Gungans from Otoh Gunga.<ref name="SW:GB" /> When the Queen of Naboo, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], returned from her voyage to acquire help, she [[Battle of the Sacred Place|met with]] the survivors from Otoh Gunga and convinced Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] to help them. Boss Nass agreed to [[Planetary Security Forces|assist in retaking]] Naboo,<ref name="SWE1" /> and set about [[Liberation of Spinnaker|gathering]] and [[Liberation of Harte Secur|rebuilding]] the Grand Army.<ref name="SW:GB" /> The Grand Army, sent out as bait for the Droid Army, was composed of two thousand Gungans and was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] under Boss Nass and the [[Bombad General/Legends|Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. The battle on [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|the plains of Naboo]] weakened the Grand Army but they succeeded nonetheless by preventing the Trade Federation's army from [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|intervening]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. 543 Gungans were killed and its leaders captured, but the destruction of the [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] shut down the Droid Army.<ref name="SW:GB Databank" />

===Clone Wars===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], around the year [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] contacted the Boss of Otoh Gunga, [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]], to ask for assistance in a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battle]]. Binks, now a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], convinced Lyonie to assist. Binks, along with a portion of the Gungan Grand Army, was sent to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] onboard a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator Star Destroyer]]. Many Gungans died in that engagement while fighting [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droids]], and many were captured when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] used a [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|Trident vessel]] to create a whirlpool. The survivors were sent to a prison camp among Mon Calamari's coral reefs.<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref> Soon after, the Mon Calamari [[Prince/Legends|prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]] visited the camp and told the prisoners to wait for his signal before attacking. Lee-Char was captured and brought before Tamson, and was scheduled to be executed. The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], Mon Calamari's other race, had joined the Separatist cause but betrayed the Separatists and freed the prisoners. The Grand Army was able to fight back, and some Gungans joined Captain Ackbar in taking down a ''Trident''-class ship. The battle was ultimately won, and Lee-Char was crowned king.<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>

[[File:Mon-Calamari.png|thumb|left|220px|The army being transported to Dac for reinforcements.]]
At a later time, there was unrest on Naboo. Rumors were circulating that the Gungans allied with the Separatist Alliance. Boss Lyonie was calling on the Grand Army to march on Theed. Amidala, now Naboo's senator, along with the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, returned to Naboo to defuse the situation. They met Binks on [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]], and the Gungan took them to Otoh Gunga to meet Lyonie. The Boss rejected their help, but Skywalker realized Lyonie was under a form of mind control from a necklace given to him by Minister [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]]. The Jedi [[Telekinesis/Legends|crushed the necklace]] and freed Lyonie. Lyonie then confronted Loo, who betrayed the Boss and stabbed him. Loo escaped from Otoh Gunga and went to the surface to inform the Grand Army that Lyonie was dead and rally them to march on Theed.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

Lyonie survived his wound but was unconscious. Skywalker saw that Binks resembled the Boss, and convinced him to pose as Boss Lyonie to call off the Grand Army's attack. They went to the surface, and Binks was able to fool the Grand Army into believing that he was Lyonie. Rish Loo, seeing that his ruse had failed, escaped deeper into the swamps on a [[Flitknot speeder/Legends|Flitknot speeder]] bike. Three [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] then entered the area and landed. One disgorged a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Naboo)/Legends|tactical droid]] with a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] escort. Binks and General Tarpals followed the tactical droid onto the landing craft, where they met General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Binks, still posing as Lyonie, told the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general that he wasn't going to go through with the attack. That angered Grievous, and Binks acquiesced and ordered Tarpals to prepare the troops. Tarpals disembarked and contacted Amidala, who suggested a strategy. Binks, meanwhile, stalled for time, but Grievous saw through the ruse and attempted to kill him. Binks escaped off the craft and saw that the Grand Army had succeeded in shutting down the droid army and was gathered around to try to capture the Separatist general. Tarpals and several other warriors [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|engaged the general in the duel]]. Grievous fatally stabbed Tarpals, who used his sacrifice to impale the cyborg leader with a spear, distracting him long enough for the other warriors to hit him with [[Booma/Legends|boomas]], knock him down, and capture him.<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

Skywalker chased Rish Loo to his secret outpost, which was in use by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the head of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Dooku killed Loo, then dueled Skywalker. Skywalker was subdued and captured, and Dooku contacted Amidala, offering a prisoner exchange: the Jedi for the General, and gave her one hour to decide. Later, a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|Sheathipede shuttle]] arrived near the gathering of the Grand Army. The tactical droid delivered the wounded Skywalker to the Naboo contingent, and the Grand Army let Grievous go. The Separatist army then left Naboo. [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee]], Naboo's current Queen, praised Binks for reuniting the Naboo and the Gungans [[Battle of the Sacred Place|again]].<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />

===Galactic Civil War===
In the period [[0 ABY/Legends|after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Grand Army militiagungs and Generals could be found in various Naboo cities.<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided">Grand Army units can be seen as NPCs in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Grand Army aided the Naboo in [[Rally on Naboo/Legends|ridding the planet]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWE6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Organization==
[[File:Militiagung2-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|200px|A kaadu-riding Militiagung wielding a cesta and booma]]
The Grand Army could only be called by the reigning Boss of Otoh Gunga.<ref name="SW:GB Databank" />
*'''[[Militiagung/Legends|Militiagungs]]'''&mdash;Gungan citizens pressed into part-time military service, armed with boomas and supplied with [[Atlatl/Legends|Atlatls]] and [[Gungan personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]]. They supply their own gear and are inexperienced but courageous.<ref name="SW:GB Databank" />
*'''Gungan Guard'''&mdash;Otoh Gunga security guards armed with double-bladed [[Electropole/Legends|electropoles]].<ref name="SW:GB Databank" />
*'[[Kaadu/Legends|''Kaadu Cavalry''']]&mdash;[[Kaadu/Legends|Kaadu]]-riding fighters armed with [[Cesta/Legends|cestas]].<ref name="SW:GB Databank" />
*'''Grand Army Officers'''&mdash;[[Captain/Legends|Captains]] and [[General/Legends|Generals]]. Generals lead individual sections of troops in battle battle and use horns, whistles and gestures to relay orders.<ref name="SW:GB Databank" />

==Equipment and vehicles==
[[File:GunganTech-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|Equipment used by the Grand Army]]
The Gungans primarily used organic technology and grew their vehicles and weapons. Much of their equipment was hand-crafted. The Grand Army's strategy was defensive-oriented with their [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]] mounted on their large animals, the [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaas]].<ref name="SW:GB Databank" /> The deflector shield blocked laser blasts but allowed slower-moving objects in.<ref name="SWE1" /> The Gungan offensive weaponry consisted of [[Spear/Legends|spears]], [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatls]], [[Electropole/Legends|Electropole]] and [[Cesta/Legends|cestas]] for throwing boomas. [[Gungan battle wagon/Legends|Gungan battle wagons]] pulled by [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]] carried large energy balls for use in [[Gungan catapult/Legends|catapults]].<ref name="SW: Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The Grand Army used kaadus as mounts for their [[Officer/Legends|officers]]<ref name="Warfare" /> and as cavalry, with their riders using [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. Other [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadus]] were mounted with weapons to serve as anti-infantry units. The Grand Army also used biological units as heavy weapons, such as [[cerrabore]]s and [[lerraa]]s, and [[Swift (creature)|swifts]]. Other heavy weapons included [[raaptur]]s. [[Glurrg]]s assisted the Grand Army as workers.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Grand Army appears in material relating to the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]''.

''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' states that the first Grand Army was formed in 100 BBY to fight off unknown invaders and unite the Gungan tribes. However, this conflicts with the fact that it was in existence thousands of years before during the War of Gungan Tribes and the Gungan-Naboo War.

Another contradiction in the [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|''Essential Guides'']] is the existence of the Gungan-Naboo War. One source states that a war occurred between [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]] and [[121 BBY]]. The ''New Essential Guide to Alien Species'' states that there was never a war between the Gungans and Naboo.

In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', the Gungan Grand Army gets its own campaign narrated by Boss Nass. The game chronicles its formation under Boss Gallo and skips to the Invasion of Naboo. The last mission is an alternate history scenario where the Grand Army outright wins the Battle of Grassy Plains and liberates Theed. The last mission in the OOM-9 (Droid Army) campaign is another alternate history scenario where the Droid Army defeats the Gungan Grand Army. The same game also establishes that, in addition to its ground army, the Gungan Grand Army also possessed a Navy (of both the aquatic and starfaring varieties), a mechanized army, an air force, and a heavy weapons division.
